heading: iPhone 17 Pro available with big discount, should you buy?
paragraphs: The iPhone 17 Pro is currently on sale with a huge discount on Croma. But should you buy it over the iPhone 18 Pro?
Coming to the deal, the iPhone 17 Pro is available for Rs 1,30,490, down from the Rs 1,34,900 launch price.
And you can save up to Rs 10,000 with bank offers. This brings the iPhone 17 Pro’s effective price to Rs 1,20,490.
If you exchange your old device, you can bring the price down further. But that will depend on the phone you trade-in.
The iPhone 17 Pro still has a lot to offer, delivering a similar experience to the iPhone 18 Pro which starts at Rs 1,64,900.
Compared to the iPhone 18 Pro, the iPhone 17 Pro starts at Rs 30,000 less, while you do get a premium package here too.
For starters, the iPhone 17 Pro uses A19 Pro chipset. This is more than enough for everyday use and even some heavy tasks like gaming.
The iPhone 17 Pro gets a 6.3-inch OLED panel with a 120Hz refresh rate. This display is quite similar to the iPhone 18 Pro but with a larger Dynamic Island.
For optics, the iPhone 17 Pro gets 3 48MP sensors – main, ultrawide, and 4x telephoto. These cameras should do a decent job for anyone who likes to capture photos or even shoot videos.
